slides.title: Digital Transformation
slides.content: **Rethinking processes, culture, and value in a digital world**

slides.title: What Is Digital Transformation?
slides.content: Digital transformation is the integration of digital technology into all areas of an organization, changing how it operates and delivers value.

slides.title: Key Drivers
slides.content: Organizations transform in response to internal and external pressures.
bullets: Competitive pressure and new business models
Advances in cloud, data, AI, and connectivity

slides.title: Core Pillars
slides.content: Successful transformation balances technology with people and process.

slides.title: Challenges
slides.content: Transformation is as much organizational as it is technical.
bullets: Skill gaps and resistance to change

slides.title: Roadmap to Success
slides.content: A pragmatic, iterative approach delivers sustainable results.
bullets: Measure progress and scale what works

slides.title: The Goal
slides.content: Create an adaptable organization that continuously delivers value through digital capabilities.
